note: Code-committed snapshot generated from in-repo ALERT_RULES. Used as fallback when operator-supplied var/sentry-alert-rules-snapshot.json is absent. Regenerate via scripts/regenerate_sentry_committed_snapshot.py whenever ALERT_RULES changes.

rules.action_hint: page on-call; check the offending tenant's recent admin activity for a 'revoke all app permissions' click
rules.name: integrations.refresh_storm
rules.summary: OAuth refresh deactivations are spiking — likely a tenant's whole-org consent was revoked or platform credentials rotated without a worker restart.

rules.action_hint: ack + monitor; if persistent >2h, raise an upstream support ticket and consider pausing the refresh worker
rules.name: integrations.refresh_transport_flap
rules.summary: OAuth refresh transport errors are spiking — likely an upstream OAuth endpoint outage. Check upstream provider status pages.

rules.action_hint: ack + fix; receiver returns 500 so upstream retries — no data loss but errors compound until resolved
rules.name: integrations.webhook_handler_crash
rules.summary: A registered webhook handler raised an unhandled exception. Inbound deliveries hit 500 and the upstream will retry.

rules.action_hint: check the affected row's config['push_subscription'] for last_renewal_error; common causes: expired access_token, revoked scope, Graph subscription id rotated upstream
rules.name: integrations.subscription_renewal_failed
rules.summary: Calendar push subscription failed to renew. Once expiry passes, tenant stops receiving push notifications until manually resubscribed.

rules.action_hint: have the tenant disconnect+reconnect the mailbox; if across multiple tenants, suspect a credential rotation issue
rules.name: integrations.mailbox_fetch_unauthorized
rules.summary: Mailbox fetch returned 401 — access_token rejected by upstream. Tenant won't see new mail until reconnected.
